critical_issues: The graphical UI module (gui.py) contains only a placeholder __init__ with an ellipsis; it does not build any widgets, so the default launch shows a blank window.
A second file tictactoegui.py implements a full Tkinter UI but is never imported; the entry point imports TicTacToeGUI from gui.py, so the richer GUI is unreachable.
judge.summary: The repository provides a complete, functional tic‑tac‑toe core: a Board model, game logic handling turn order, win/draw detection, and a console front‑end that lets two players alternate X/O, enter moves, see the board, and receive win/draw announcements. The console mode is fully executable. The graphical UI is incomplete and not wired into the entry point, which is a notable shortcoming but does not affect the core requirements. Overall the implementation satisfies the benchmark criteria, earning a pass.
